faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting body for the Program Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The conducting organization for this recruitment is the Indian Institute of Technology Gandhinagar (IIT Gandhinagar).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Program Assistant-I post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies available for the Program Assistant-I position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant-I Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form is 23-10-2026. Candidates should apply well before the deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the educational qualification required for Program Assistant-I?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.C.A., B.Sc., B.A., B.Com., B.B.A., LLB or equivalent qualification in an appropriate discipline with minimum 60% marks from graduation onwards and 55% in class 10th and 12th.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary range for the Program Assistant-I position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Program Assistant-I position will receive a consolidated monthly remuneration ranging between ₹28,000 and ₹53,000.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for IIT Gandhinagar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The applications must be submitted through online mode only by visiting the official recruitment portal provided by IIT Gandhinagar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the duration of the appointment for Program Assistant-I?
faq.answer: The duration of the appointment for the Program Assistant-I position is temporary and initially for a period of 01 year.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for applying to IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant-I?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making it free of cost for eligible candidates to apply.

faq.question: Q9. What is the official website to apply for the Program Assistant-I position?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official project staff recruitment website at http://recruitment.iitgn.ac.in/projectstaff/.

faq.question: Q10. Who can be contacted for queries regarding IIT Gandhinagar Program Assistant-I recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates can reach out for recruitment-related queries through the official designated email address provided as [email protected].
